model.name: BUG1: Chain section shows Task as its own chain node + mixes non-chain nodes.
model.description: BUG: the Traceability Chain section in the detail-view shows the TASK as its OWN chain node (self-referential — the Task appears in its own traced chain) and mixes in non-chain nodes (all methods instead of chain-relevant only). The chain should show ONLY the singular traced path (req→uc→class→method→impl→test) — Task is NAVIGATION, not a chain node (locked 6-step standard). Ties to R20.5-A (chain shows only traced-chain nodes).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "do you see the issues on this requirement and the need for change requests and bugs regarding traceability and stupid champagne marketing?"
model.crossRefNote: R20.5-A (Traceability Chain = chain-only nodes) defines the correct behavior. BUG1 is the specific bug: Task self-referential in chain + non-chain nodes mixed in.

intendedChain.useCase: detailView.chainExcludesSelf — chain section excludes the current node (no self-reference) and shows only traced-chain nodes
intendedChain.method: renderTraceabilitySection — filter out self-node + non-chain nodes
intendedChain.test: RED: open Task detail → assert Task does NOT appear as a node in its own Traceability Chain section. Assert only req→uc→class→method→impl→test nodes appear. Currently FAILS (Task shown as chain node + all methods mixed in).
